meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把混乱的代码拆解重组，理清结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头代码越改越乱，想在不改行为的前提下梳理结构
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code apart and rebuild it into clear structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has grown messy and you want to reorganize it without changing behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先确认重构目标，再建代码地图、评估测试覆盖、生成分步计划，用 LSP 与 AST 工具逐步改写，每步跑测试验证，最后做整体回归检查。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、提取或现代化代码时触发；若目标含糊（比如只说「清理一下」）或范围不明，它会先反问具体目标再动手。

say.note: 先建代码地图和测试覆盖评估，再分步重构

say.text: 把 src/utils 里的校验逻辑提取成独立模块
say.note: 按明确变换请求走完整流程

howto.what_en: After install, Claude confirms the refactor goal, builds a codemap, checks test coverage, generates a step-by-step plan, edits with LSP and AST-grep, runs tests after each step, and ends with a full regression check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code. If the target or scope is unclear, it asks a clarifying question first.

say_en.note: Maps code and test coverage, then refactors step by step
Limits scope to the module, conservative strategy

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in src/utils into its own module
say_en.note: Treated as a clear transformation request
